jobs.caption: Create a short subtle dungeon memory-game ambience loop for a portfolio demo, low volume, seamless, non-distracting, with soft room tone and faint magical texture.

Create a cohesive Memory Dungeon audio micro-pack: short subtle dungeon-arcade cues for match success, mistake, relic offer shimmer, countdown pressure pulse, and floor clear. Keep each cue clean, non-intrusive, loop-safe where relevant, and suitable for a polished browser/Electron portfolio demo.
